description: This is a Java source file that defines a Fragment class (SchedulerFragment) used in an Android application to manage and display scheduled alarms. It includes fields, lifecycle methods, and inner classes for handling alarm registration, user interactions, and BroadcastReceiver callbacks.

classes.name: SchedulerFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays scheduled alarms and allows users to add new alarms via a TimePicker dialog. It manages alarm registration, display, and handling alarm broadcasts.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Registers a BroadcastReceiver to listen for alarm events when the activity is created.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from the XML resource.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI elements like the FloatingActionButton, RecyclerView, and sets up alarm storage and adapter. Also sets up click handlers for adding alarms.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters the BroadcastReceiver to prevent memory leaks when the fragment is destroyed.
